items.question: What is the overall capacity, in units, of the largest 'freezer farm' in the UAE developed by the Hope Consortium for COVID-19 vaccines?
items.fact: Hope Consortium freezer farm has 53 units capacity

items.question: Within how many hours can the Dubai Vaccine Logistics Alliance distribute COVID-19 vaccines to any point around the world?
items.fact: Dubai Vaccine Logistics Alliance distributes vaccines worldwide within 48 hours
